name: firefox-apollo-theme
description: A high-contrast Firefox theme generated from the canonical Apollo palette.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --warnings-as-errors --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md CLAUDE.md LICENSE palette scripts tests .github
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --filename firefox-apollo-theme.zip --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md CLAUDE.md LICENSE palette scripts tests .github
